00:29:25,717 --> 00:29:28,013
And now you've got
our son doing it.

435
00:29:28,086 --> 00:29:29,811
Card? Card?

436
00:29:29,886 --> 00:29:31,051
You heard me.

437
00:29:31,118 --> 00:29:32,482
Oh, so it's
all me, huh?

438
00:29:32,557 --> 00:29:35,083
Our Sonny boy? You had
nothing to do with it?

439
00:29:35,155 --> 00:29:38,252
It wears you down, Tony.
That's all I'm saying.

440
00:29:38,327 --> 00:29:41,363
Do you have any idea what it's
like to spend day after day

441
00:29:41,427 --> 00:29:43,860
With somebody who is
constantly complaining?

442
00:29:46,395 --> 00:29:47,701
Fuck you.

443
00:30:06,158 --> 00:30:08,480
It could have been
a cry for help.

444
00:30:08,557 --> 00:30:11,553
<i>Aren't you listening?
He did cry for help.</i>

445
00:30:11,627 --> 00:30:14,160
<i>He's lucky I came
home and heard him.</i>

446
00:30:14,227 --> 00:30:16,592
I meant
the botched attempt.

447
00:30:16,666 --> 00:30:18,991
<i>On some level,
he may have known</i>

448
00:30:19,068 --> 00:30:21,903
That the rope was too long
to keep him submerged.

449
00:30:21,965 --> 00:30:24,473
Or he could just be
a fuckin' idiot.

450
00:30:24,537 --> 00:30:26,703
Historically,
that's been the case.

451
00:30:30,545 --> 00:30:33,712
Me and Carm were
getting along so good too.

452
00:30:37,115 --> 00:30:39,351
My father and his
panic attacks,

453
00:30:39,416 --> 00:30:41,483
My fuckin'
demented uncle,

454
00:30:41,557 --> 00:30:46,220
Not to mention the other one--
Eckley the fuckin' retard.

455
00:30:46,295 --> 00:30:49,863
You think there are other reasons
why your son is so unhappy?

456
00:30:49,925 --> 00:30:53,430
He's got the world
by the balls--

457
00:30:53,495 --> 00:30:55,732
Every fuckin' advantage--

458
00:30:55,806 --> 00:30:59,232
And he hits one little pothole
and he goes into hysterics.

459
00:31:02,747 --> 00:31:04,570
Yeah, I know.

460
00:31:07,218 --> 00:31:09,142
I'm not taking
the rap,

461
00:31:09,218 --> 00:31:10,512
Not completely.

462
00:31:12,415 --> 00:31:14,920
She coddled him, his mother.
I said it before.

463
00:31:17,256 --> 00:31:19,593
Every little problem,
she's right there

464
00:31:19,655 --> 00:31:21,590
To pick him up
and wipe off his tears

465
00:31:21,667 --> 00:31:23,760
On her apron strings.

466
00:31:23,825 --> 00:31:26,460
Children need
to feel safe.

467
00:31:26,535 --> 00:31:29,132
I'm sure that made him
into the man he is today.

468
00:31:29,205 --> 00:31:31,430
Are you ashamed of him?

469
00:31:35,906 --> 00:31:38,041
Yeah, actually I am.

470
00:31:39,275 --> 00:31:41,242
The coward's way out.

471
00:31:41,317 --> 00:31:43,040
Isn't that
what they call it?

472
00:31:43,116 --> 00:31:47,180
I think whoever said that
didn't understand depression.

473
00:31:47,256 --> 00:31:50,450
But you do, don't you?

474
00:32:02,235 --> 00:32:03,530
Where's dad?

475
00:32:03,608 --> 00:32:06,400
Oh, Meadow got rear-Ended
on bloomfield avenue.

476
00:32:06,475 --> 00:32:09,570
- He'll come see you later.
- Is he still mad?

477
00:32:09,646 --> 00:32:11,413
He was never mad, A.J.

478
00:32:11,478 --> 00:32:12,911
He loves you.

479
00:32:16,215 --> 00:32:18,052
How long do
I have to stay here?

480
00:32:18,118 --> 00:32:20,110
Dr. Vogel thinks it
might be a good idea

481
00:32:20,186 --> 00:32:23,053
For the time being
just to take a time-Out.

482
00:32:23,128 --> 00:32:24,623
Like I'm in preschool?

483
00:32:37,466 --> 00:32:39,502
Did you see
Dr. Vogel today?

484
00:32:39,576 --> 00:32:41,572
Today we have group.

485
00:32:50,858 --> 00:32:52,550
Did you eat today?

486
00:32:52,616 --> 00:32:55,322
I had some turkey.
It had no flavor at all.

487
00:32:55,386 --> 00:32:58,153
I'll bring some
chicken parm tomorrow.

488
00:32:59,526 --> 00:33:01,190
I don't think
that's allowed

489
00:33:01,265 --> 00:33:03,220
On account of all
the bulimic girls.

490
00:33:08,408 --> 00:33:11,232
So it's front-Row mezzanine
at "grey gardens,"

491
00:33:11,308 --> 00:33:12,871
- And the guy says--
- Excuse me?

492
00:33:14,347 --> 00:33:17,142
- You're Tony Soprano's kid, right?
- Yeah.

493
00:33:17,206 --> 00:33:19,970
Small world, running
into you like this, huh?

494
00:33:20,047 --> 00:33:21,540
I'm sorry,
do I know you?

495
00:33:21,616 --> 00:33:24,182
You got a little cream
on your mouth there, sweetie.

496
00:33:24,286 --> 00:33:26,353
Be happy to add to it.

497
00:33:26,418 --> 00:33:27,752
<i>- What?
- Excuse me.</i>

498
00:33:27,825 --> 00:33:29,782
<i>Lucky guy, her dad.</i>

499
00:33:29,855 --> 00:33:32,952
Must be fun tucking her
in at night, huh?

500
00:33:33,026 --> 00:33:35,720
- Do you have a problem?
- Not yet.

501
00:33:35,797 --> 00:33:37,892
Would you like one?

502
00:33:37,965 --> 00:33:39,433
Coco, come on.

503
00:33:39,498 --> 00:33:41,203
What?
I'm saying hello.

504
00:33:41,268 --> 00:33:43,233
Come on,
let's go.

505
00:33:43,308 --> 00:33:45,173
Hey, best to
your dad, huh?

506
00:33:52,417 --> 00:33:54,240
What the hell
was that?

507
00:33:57,387 --> 00:33:59,713
...but that is not
for you to decide.

508
00:33:59,788 --> 00:34:02,221
Don't say anything.

509
00:34:04,257 --> 00:34:06,651
What, are you two talking
about me again?

510
00:34:11,666 --> 00:34:13,330
What's the matter?

511
00:34:13,395 --> 00:34:14,930
Nothing.

512
00:34:16,406 --> 00:34:18,130
What?

513
00:34:21,976 --> 00:34:24,143
Do you know a guy
named coco?

514
00:34:24,216 --> 00:34:26,443
Why?

515
00:34:26,517 --> 00:34:28,310
She was out
on a date last night

516
00:34:28,385 --> 00:34:30,443
<i>And he came over
and pulled some crap.</i>

517
00:34:30,515 --> 00:34:32,213
What?

518
00:34:33,318 --> 00:34:34,822
How?

519
00:34:34,887 --> 00:34:36,550
We were in the city,
little Italy.

520
00:34:36,625 --> 00:34:38,421
We were
having dessert, and...

521
00:34:38,498 --> 00:34:40,120
he came up
out of nowhere

522
00:34:40,196 --> 00:34:42,923
And just started saying
all this weird stuff.

523
00:34:42,997 --> 00:34:45,332
What kind of weird stuff?

524
00:34:45,395 --> 00:34:47,091
How he'd like
to tuck me in at night.

525
00:34:47,168 --> 00:34:48,933
Stuff like that.

526
00:34:49,007 --> 00:34:52,501
- Tuck you in?
- I could smell the sambuca on his breath.

527
00:34:54,205 --> 00:34:56,771
What exactly
did he say?

528
00:34:56,847 --> 00:34:59,540
He came up to us

529
00:34:59,618 --> 00:35:02,210
And he asked me if
I was your daughter

530
00:35:02,288 --> 00:35:05,882
And then he said
I had whipped cream

531
00:35:05,958 --> 00:35:07,410
On my mouth.

532
00:35:07,487 --> 00:35:09,622
Yeah?

533
00:35:10,685 --> 00:35:12,320
What else did he say?

534
00:35:18,666 --> 00:35:21,102
It's all right.

535
00:35:21,168 --> 00:35:24,032
It's okay.
He's an idiot,

536
00:35:24,108 --> 00:35:26,171
But he's harmless.

537
00:35:27,408 --> 00:35:28,900
I'll talk
to somebody.

538
00:35:33,647 --> 00:35:35,440
So this boy
you're dating,

539
00:35:35,518 --> 00:35:38,052
This man,
who is he?

540
00:35:38,118 --> 00:35:40,750
You promise not to start
with an inquisition?

541
00:35:40,828 --> 00:35:43,120
Will you stop with all
the secrecy, please?

542
00:35:44,698 --> 00:35:48,562
- It's patrick Parisi, okay?
- You're kidding me?

543
00:35:48,627 --> 00:35:50,961
That's exactly why I didn't
want to tell you guys,

544
00:35:51,037 --> 00:35:52,591
And why he didn't tell
uncle Patsy.

545
00:35:54,307 --> 00:35:56,533
I thought he--
Where are you going?

546
00:35:56,606 --> 00:35:58,973
Meeting-- Sil.

547
00:35:59,036 --> 00:36:01,241
We have vogel later,
don't forget.

548
00:36:03,708 --> 00:36:05,643
I thought pat Parisi
was engaged.

549
00:36:05,717 --> 00:36:07,213
They broke it off.

550
00:36:07,278 --> 00:36:09,410
We kind of hooked up
at the "cleaver" premiere,

551
00:36:09,488 --> 00:36:11,711
We started talking.

552
00:36:11,785 --> 00:36:13,652
He's changed a lot.

553
00:36:13,718 --> 00:36:15,520
I really like him.

554
00:36:15,587 --> 00:36:18,020
So why the big mystery
all this time?

555
00:36:18,096 --> 00:36:20,692
I knew you and daddy
never liked him.

556
00:36:20,755 --> 00:36:22,392
No, it's not that
we didn't like him,

557
00:36:22,467 --> 00:36:24,091
It's just...

558
00:36:26,398 --> 00:36:28,732
so all those times
you told me

559
00:36:28,805 --> 00:36:31,132
You were staying with your
friend kimmie in the city,

560
00:36:31,208 --> 00:36:33,471
I suppose you were staying
at his apartment?

561
00:36:33,538 --> 00:36:34,970
Sometimes.

562
00:36:38,277 --> 00:36:40,611
Look, there's
something else.

563
00:36:40,675 --> 00:36:42,483
What?

564
00:36:43,948 --> 00:36:46,311
I've decided not
to go to med school.

565
00:36:46,386 --> 00:36:48,420
What? Why?

566
00:36:48,485 --> 00:36:50,753
Oh, it's just too hard.

567
00:36:50,828 --> 00:36:54,390
- Isn't anything that's worthwhile?
- You have no idea.

568
00:36:54,468 --> 00:36:57,363
<i>- Of course not.
- Don't get sarcastic.</i>

569
00:36:57,428 --> 00:37:00,361
I really think
it's law for me.

570
00:37:00,438 --> 00:37:03,900
I mean, you should hear patrick
talk about the justice system

571
00:37:03,968 --> 00:37:05,730
And what it means.

572
00:37:05,807 --> 00:37:07,771
It's really inspiring.

573
00:37:21,257 --> 00:37:25,223
Obviously Sheila resents me.
I'm dating her father.

574
00:37:26,226 --> 00:37:29,821
The sullen looks,
the transference to me

575
00:37:29,896 --> 00:37:31,732
Of her issues
with her mom...

576
00:37:31,795 --> 00:37:33,593
as your favorite
patient says,

577
00:37:33,665 --> 00:37:36,403
"Maybe I should put
my shoe up her ass?"

578
00:37:36,465 --> 00:37:39,172
Which patient of mine
says that?

579
00:37:39,235 --> 00:37:40,670
Mine, Elliot.

580
00:37:40,736 --> 00:37:43,342
Your favorite patient
of mine?

581
00:37:43,406 --> 00:37:45,542
Oh.

582
00:37:45,617 --> 00:37:48,581
He hasn't been
in the paper much lately.

583
00:37:48,647 --> 00:37:50,810
You miss that,
don't you?

584
00:37:50,886 --> 00:37:53,480
My father was a rabid
"untouchables" fan.

585
00:37:53,555 --> 00:37:55,252
Make of that
what you will.

586
00:38:00,327 --> 00:38:01,591
What, Elliot?

587
00:38:01,666 --> 00:38:04,233
I ran into nancy duggan
last week.

588
00:38:04,296 --> 00:38:07,190
- Do you know nancy?
- Vaguely.

589
00:38:07,266 --> 00:38:09,100
She's on staff
at rikers island,

590
00:38:09,166 --> 00:38:11,800
Works with a lot of
sociopaths, as you can imagine.

591
00:38:11,878 --> 00:38:15,443
Anyway, she told me
something interesting.

592
00:38:15,505 --> 00:38:18,572
A lot of studies
about talk therapy

593
00:38:18,648 --> 00:38:21,111
As it relates
to sociopaths

594
00:38:21,186 --> 00:38:22,280
<i>And criminals,</i>

595
00:38:22,345 --> 00:38:25,810
One of them is the
criminal personality

596
00:38:25,885 --> 00:38:28,882
Conducted by yochelson
at St. Elizabeth's.

597
00:38:28,958 --> 00:38:30,750
<i>Essentially</i>

598
00:38:30,826 --> 00:38:32,651
It concludes

599
00:38:32,727 --> 00:38:35,022
That talk therapy,

600
00:38:35,097 --> 00:38:38,560
While not only being
useless with sociopaths,

601
00:38:38,638 --> 00:38:41,260
Actually serves
to validate them.

602
00:38:43,105 --> 00:38:46,300
Yochelson says they sharpen
their skills as conmen

603
00:38:46,378 --> 00:38:49,342
On their therapists.

604
00:38:49,408 --> 00:38:52,573
Crocodile tears,
what have you.

605
00:38:52,648 --> 00:38:54,682
Why are you smirking?

606
00:38:54,748 --> 00:38:57,282
- I'm not.
- Oh really?

607
00:38:57,348 --> 00:38:59,951
We showed data.

608
00:39:00,016 --> 00:39:02,950
The one-Year
reconviction rates

609
00:39:03,028 --> 00:39:05,650
Were higher for offenders in therapy

610
00:39:05,728 --> 00:39:09,163
Than for those receiving
no treatment at all.

611
00:39:17,367 --> 00:39:20,330
Uh, some peppers
and cheese.

612
00:39:20,406 --> 00:39:23,071
<i>Eh, gorgonzola,
all right? Don't forget.</i>

613
00:39:26,576 --> 00:39:27,640
Whoa whoa!

614
00:39:27,716 --> 00:39:29,213
Sit down.

615
00:39:29,285 --> 00:39:31,580
- Sit down.
- Easy easy.

616
00:39:33,988 --> 00:39:36,881
You motherfucker.
My fucking daughter?

617
00:39:36,958 --> 00:39:39,753
My fucking daughter,
you motherfucker.

618
00:39:39,825 --> 00:39:41,420
My fuckin' daughter!

619
00:39:42,528 --> 00:39:44,193
Hey, want some
sambuca with this?

620
00:39:44,265 --> 00:39:47,192
Tony, you're making
a big fuckin' mistake here.

621
00:39:49,338 --> 00:39:51,930
How about I put a bullet
in your fuckin' head, huh?

622
00:40:00,446 --> 00:40:02,113
Don't do it!

623
00:40:08,555 --> 00:40:10,123
You want some?

624
00:40:25,606 --> 00:40:27,541
<i>It's always what
you think, isn't it?</i>

625
00:40:27,606 --> 00:40:29,800
<i>It's never how I feel.</i>

626
00:40:31,915 --> 00:40:33,910
Oh, poor you.

627
00:40:33,978 --> 00:40:35,942
It's all your mother's
fault, isn't it?

628
00:40:36,018 --> 00:40:38,911
- I didn't say that.
- You're a mama's boy.

629
00:40:38,986 --> 00:40:40,881
You're gonna
call me names now?

630
00:40:40,955 --> 00:40:43,080
No one is calling
anyone any names.

631
00:40:43,156 --> 00:40:44,651
How about
my confirmation?

632
00:40:44,728 --> 00:40:46,291
You called me
an animal.

633
00:40:46,355 --> 00:40:48,020
I did not!

634
00:40:48,098 --> 00:40:50,293
I was in the garage
and you said,

635
00:40:50,366 --> 00:40:53,260
"What kind of animal smokes
marijuana at his confirmation?"

636
00:40:53,336 --> 00:40:56,760
He was using illegal drugs
in the home.

637
00:40:56,836 --> 00:41:01,343
Did it ever occur to you that I
might have been self-Medicating?

638
00:41:01,405 --> 00:41:03,340
Give me a break,
will you?

639
00:41:04,578 --> 00:41:07,271
And how about
second grade?

640
00:41:07,345 --> 00:41:10,040
You made me show up to
school in that dorky raincoat.

641
00:41:11,186 --> 00:41:12,953
I got beat up
because of it.

642
00:41:15,328 --> 00:41:18,750
You would hole
up in that room for hours.

643
00:41:18,827 --> 00:41:23,320
Because I was never really secure
expressing my feelings in that house.

644
00:41:23,395 --> 00:41:25,532
I mean, that's why.

645
00:41:32,278 --> 00:41:35,541
What kind of poem is that
to teach college students?

646
00:41:42,986 --> 00:41:44,681
Would you like
to tell your parents

647
00:41:44,757 --> 00:41:46,453
What your
grandmother said?

648
00:41:46,518 --> 00:41:48,481
My mother?

649
00:41:51,358 --> 00:41:54,192
Grandma--
Dad's mom.

650
00:41:54,266 --> 00:41:56,121
What'd she say?

651
00:41:56,196 --> 00:41:58,562
That it's all
a big nothing.

652
00:41:58,635 --> 00:42:00,430
What is?

653
00:42:00,495 --> 00:42:02,230
Life.

654
00:42:05,536 --> 00:42:07,172
That was her,
all right.

655
00:42:07,236 --> 00:42:09,670
Okay, fine, she said
those kinds of things--

656
00:42:09,746 --> 00:42:12,273
She sat up in bed--

657
00:42:12,346 --> 00:42:14,913
When she could
hardly move.

658
00:42:14,987 --> 00:42:16,813
She could hardly
breathe.

659
00:42:18,555 --> 00:42:22,650
She said in the end that your
friends and family let you down,

660
00:42:22,726 --> 00:42:25,321
And that you die
in your own arms.

661
00:42:25,398 --> 00:42:27,020
When was this?

662
00:42:27,098 --> 00:42:28,922
When she was
in that nursing home

663
00:42:28,996 --> 00:42:30,491
And you used
to make me go see her.

664
00:42:36,868 --> 00:42:39,533
We're not too young
to be grandpas.

665
00:42:44,615 --> 00:42:46,613
Ton'?

666
00:42:46,675 --> 00:42:49,041
Carmine Lupertazzi.

667
00:42:49,117 --> 00:42:51,350
- I'll see you later, skip.
- All right.

668
00:42:53,485 --> 00:42:55,122
We should have dinner,

669
00:42:55,186 --> 00:42:57,220
You know, Carm,
Donna, maybe the kids.

670
00:42:57,288 --> 00:42:58,353
Yeah.

671
00:42:58,428 --> 00:43:00,893
I hear wedding bells
are in the air.

672
00:43:06,368 --> 00:43:08,201
You want anything?

673
00:43:08,268 --> 00:43:10,000
No, I'm good.

674
00:43:18,416 --> 00:43:21,183
If there's anything I can
do, Tony, for Anthony jr....

675
00:43:21,246 --> 00:43:23,211
thank you.

676
00:43:23,287 --> 00:43:26,112
When alexandra had
that bout of anorexia,

677
00:43:26,186 --> 00:43:28,481
We had this terrific
psychologist.

678
00:43:28,557 --> 00:43:31,021
She tried to kill herself,
your daughter?

679
00:43:31,095 --> 00:43:32,591
No.

680
00:43:32,658 --> 00:43:35,221
She had serious problems
though, didn't she?

681
00:43:35,296 --> 00:43:38,061
Not really.
It's all under control.

682
00:43:41,108 --> 00:43:43,062
So...

683
00:43:43,135 --> 00:43:45,103
the reason I'm here

684
00:43:45,175 --> 00:43:46,731
You could
probably guess.

685
00:43:46,805 --> 00:43:49,742
What happened
at coco's restaurant.

686
00:43:49,808 --> 00:43:53,172
This alteration
you had with him--

687
00:43:53,245 --> 00:43:55,280
You're at
the precipice, Tony,

688
00:43:55,345 --> 00:43:57,610
Of an enormous crossroad.

689
00:43:57,688 --> 00:44:00,923
Phil's considering shutting
down the hackensack mall project

690
00:44:00,986 --> 00:44:03,020
With a plumbing strike
as we speak.

691
00:44:03,087 --> 00:44:05,122
Fuck it.
Let him.

692
00:44:05,196 --> 00:44:07,622
Easy for you. I have
the scaffolding contract.

693
00:44:07,696 --> 00:44:09,590
Oh, is that what
this is about, Carmine?

694
00:44:09,666 --> 00:44:10,990
What do I owe you?

695
00:44:11,065 --> 00:44:14,163
Come on, huh?
You know me better than that.

696
00:44:14,235 --> 00:44:16,831
My daughter, Carmine.
My daughter.

697
00:44:17,877 --> 00:44:19,671
You got a little girl.

698
00:44:19,738 --> 00:44:21,203
You almost
killed the guy.

699
00:44:21,278 --> 00:44:23,940
I should've killed him.
I'd have had total support,

700
00:44:24,008 --> 00:44:27,581
- But I held myself back!
- You were being prudent.

701
00:44:27,646 --> 00:44:29,343
Fuck that.

702
00:44:33,057 --> 00:44:34,783
I lost it.

703
00:44:36,157 --> 00:44:38,792
Timing couldn't have been
worse, but what the fuck?

704
00:44:38,855 --> 00:44:40,690
So you go to Phil,

705
00:44:40,756 --> 00:44:43,221
I go with you,
hats in hand,

706
00:44:43,296 --> 00:44:44,493
Bended knees.

707
00:44:58,546 --> 00:45:01,411
Why me, huh?

708
00:45:01,487 --> 00:45:03,941
Doesn't every parent
make mistakes?

709
00:45:04,017 --> 00:45:06,510
Why not you?

710
00:45:06,588 --> 00:45:08,381
'Cause I'm
a good guy...

711
00:45:08,458 --> 00:45:10,150
basically.

712
00:45:11,898 --> 00:45:13,722
I love my family.

713
00:45:16,066 --> 00:45:18,831
There's a balance.
There's a ying and a yang.

714
00:45:18,898 --> 00:45:20,360
Huh?

715
00:45:26,136 --> 00:45:29,871
You think you know.
You think you learned something.

716
00:45:31,675 --> 00:45:33,272
Like when I got shot.

717
00:45:33,348 --> 00:45:35,840
Know what?

718
00:45:38,987 --> 00:45:41,321
All right.

719
00:45:41,385 --> 00:45:45,523
When I was in Las Vegas,
I took peyote.

720
00:45:46,855 --> 00:45:49,421
Curiosity,
I don't know.

721
00:45:49,497 --> 00:45:51,290
You were searching
for something.

722
00:45:53,537 --> 00:45:57,030
Well, I saw some things.
Not...

723
00:45:57,105 --> 00:45:59,233
things, per se,
hallucinations,

724
00:45:59,307 --> 00:46:01,302
<i>Roger corman shit.</i>

725
00:46:01,376 --> 00:46:05,013
- It was kind of disappointing, there wasn't any of that.
- What was there?

726
00:46:05,076 --> 00:46:06,940
It's kind of hard
to describe.

727
00:46:08,848 --> 00:46:11,411
I mean, you've done it, right?
Acid, shit like that.

728
00:46:11,487 --> 00:46:12,911
No.

729
00:46:19,126 --> 00:46:21,523
All I can say is

730
00:46:21,595 --> 00:46:25,133
I saw,
for pretty certain,

731
00:46:25,195 --> 00:46:27,333
That this...

732
00:46:27,396 --> 00:46:29,833
<i>everything we see
and experience,</i>

733
00:46:29,908 --> 00:46:31,531
Is not all there is.

734
00:46:31,608 --> 00:46:34,103
What else is there?

735
00:46:35,147 --> 00:46:37,202
Something else.

736
00:46:39,816 --> 00:46:41,640
But that's as far as
I'm gonna go with it.

737
00:46:41,718 --> 00:46:44,513
I don't fuckin' know.

738
00:46:44,585 --> 00:46:46,812
Alternate universes?

739
00:46:46,888 --> 00:46:48,753
You gonna be
a fuckin' comedian now?

740
00:46:48,826 --> 00:46:50,550
I'm not.

741
00:46:52,757 --> 00:46:53,922
Maybe.

742
00:46:56,225 --> 00:46:58,531
This is gonna
sound stupid...

743
00:47:00,496 --> 00:47:03,732
but I saw at one point
that our mothers are...

744
00:47:06,805 --> 00:47:09,872
they're bus drivers.

745
00:47:14,348 --> 00:47:16,612
They're--
No, they are the bus.

746
00:47:16,687 --> 00:47:19,710
See, they're the vehicle
that gets us here.

747
00:47:19,788 --> 00:47:23,423
They drop us off
and go on their way.

748
00:47:23,485 --> 00:47:25,390
They continue
on their journey.

749
00:47:25,456 --> 00:47:28,762
And the problem is that we keep
trying to get back on the bus,

750
00:47:28,827 --> 00:47:31,733
Instead of just
letting it go.

751
00:47:36,037 --> 00:47:38,271
That's very insightful.

752
00:47:38,335 --> 00:47:40,530
Jesus, don't act
so surprised.

753
00:47:49,385 --> 00:47:51,483
You know...

754
00:47:51,558 --> 00:47:54,651
you have these thoughts,
and you almost grab it.

755
00:47:54,725 --> 00:47:57,080
<i>And then...</i>

756
00:47:57,158 --> 00:47:59,451
pfft.

757
00:48:05,397 --> 00:48:07,133
Butch, how are you?

758
00:48:07,197 --> 00:48:10,160
Phil is not accepting
visitors right now.

759
00:48:10,238 --> 00:48:12,273
I just talked to him
on the phone, butchie.

760
00:48:12,336 --> 00:48:13,931
I just talked
to him in person.

761
00:48:14,005 --> 00:48:15,740
He ain't seeing nobody.

762
00:48:15,807 --> 00:48:17,610
What's going on, butch?

763
00:48:17,677 --> 00:48:19,572
I just brokered
this thing.

764
00:48:19,645 --> 00:48:21,683
He came here to make
a peace offering.

765
00:48:21,746 --> 00:48:24,282
A semi-Trailer of drills--
Makitas.

766
00:48:24,357 --> 00:48:26,811
We don't want
your fuckin' drills.

767
00:48:26,886 --> 00:48:28,382
Fuck it.

768
00:48:28,456 --> 00:48:30,081
Let's go.

769
00:48:45,608 --> 00:48:47,970
<i>That's right, cocksucker!</i>

770
00:48:48,046 --> 00:48:50,573
- Go back to new Jersey!
- Phil, what are you doin'?

771
00:48:50,645 --> 00:48:53,311
Take that piece of shit
and get off my stoop.

772
00:48:53,377 --> 00:48:55,410
But we just
talked about this.

773
00:48:55,485 --> 00:48:57,380
Well, cooler heads
prevailed.

774
00:48:57,448 --> 00:49:00,452
- Uncle philly!
- Uncle philly my ass.

775
00:49:00,517 --> 00:49:03,051
Will you just come down
so we can discuss this?

776
00:49:03,128 --> 00:49:05,753
There's nothing left
to discuss, Carmine.

777
00:49:09,868 --> 00:49:11,561
I don't understand.

778
00:49:11,636 --> 00:49:13,632
Why is he like this?

779
00:49:19,505 --> 00:49:22,203
<i>Hey, it's sleeping beauty.</i>

780
00:49:22,278 --> 00:49:23,742
I didn't sleep a wink.

781
00:49:23,805 --> 00:49:25,771
<i>I know, we've been
waiting for you.</i>

782
00:49:25,848 --> 00:49:27,581
<i>We have the chess set
all ready.</i>

783
00:49:27,646 --> 00:49:30,511
<i>- He cheats.
- Hello, honest abe?</i>

784
00:49:30,585 --> 00:49:33,451
<i>- Whatever.
- We just haven't played for so long.</i>

785
00:49:33,515 --> 00:49:35,722
I know, I just got
all this stress at work.

786
00:49:35,786 --> 00:49:37,720
It's cool, it happens
to a lot of people.

787
00:49:37,797 --> 00:49:39,793
- Really?
- Absolutely.

788
00:49:39,857 --> 00:49:42,121
More than half of adults
report experiencing

789
00:49:42,196 --> 00:49:44,730
<i>Some kind of insomnia at
least a few nights a week.</i>

790
00:49:44,798 --> 00:49:47,031
<i>We just
want you back.</i>

791
00:49:47,096 --> 00:49:49,061
<i>- Thanks, guys.
- When you can't sleep...</i>

792
00:50:02,087 --> 00:50:04,150
no food in
the unit, sir.



## S06E20

1
00:00:00,000 --> 00:00:04,162
WWW.MY-SUBS.CO

1
00:01:45,705 --> 00:01:48,240
¿Qué rayos haces?
Casi me matas del susto.

2
00:01:48,241 --> 00:01:51,743
Algunas cosas no se pueden
hablar por teléfono.

3
00:01:51,744 --> 00:01:54,913
Entiendo.
Lorraine fue a misa.

4
00:01:54,914 --> 00:01:56,848
Cuidado con Spencer.

5
00:01:56,849 --> 00:02:00,419
- ¿Quién?
- Su maldito toy terrier es una máquina de cagar.

6
00:02:03,924 --> 00:02:06,725
Hablé con algunos de los
muchachos de tus recelos.

7
00:02:06,926 --> 00:02:08,493
¿Sí?

8
00:02:45,465 --> 00:02:47,633
Escuchad,
tomé una decisión.

9
00:02:49,269 --> 00:02:52,138
A pasear.

10
00:02:53,239 --> 00:02:55,574
¿Qué demonios esperáis?
Fuera de aquí.

11
00:03:00,680 --> 00:03:03,782
Históricamente, Carmine
siempre dijo que los Soprano...

12
00:03:03,783 --> 00:03:06,385
no son más que una
tropa sobrevalorada.

13
00:03:06,386 --> 00:03:09,588
Simple y llano,
los decapitamos...

14
00:03:09,589 --> 00:03:11,590
y hacemos negocio con
lo que sea que quede.

15
00:03:13,459 --> 00:03:15,460
- ¿Qué?
- Nada.

16
00:03:15,461 --> 00:03:17,663
Estoy de acuerdo en espíritu,
pero debo aconsejar.

17
00:03:17,664 --> 00:03:19,998
Esto debería haberse hecho
cuando John era jefe.

18
00:03:19,999 --> 00:03:22,267
Tienen alta gerencia
sobredimensionada,...

19
00:03:22,268 --> 00:03:24,069
que se lleva la mitad
de las ganancias.

20
00:03:24,070 --> 00:03:26,472
Los eliminamos, absorbemos
todo el maldito asunto.

21
00:03:26,573 --> 00:03:28,908
¿Eliminar a una maldita
familia entera?

22
00:03:29,009 --> 00:03:31,377
Déjame decirte un
par o tres cosas:

23
00:03:31,678 --> 00:03:34,579
Olvida a Coco.
Olvida a Fat Dom...

24
00:03:34,580 --> 00:03:37,282
que se fue a Jersey
y nunca volvió.

25
00:03:37,283 --> 00:03:39,418
Olvida a mi hermano Billy.

26
00:03:39,419 --> 00:03:41,953
Phil, Phil, no es eso
lo que digo en absoluto.

27
00:03:41,954 --> 00:03:45,223
Anthony Soprano
no respeta esto.

28
00:03:45,224 --> 00:03:48,193
Nunca estuvo tras rejas,
no realmente.

29
00:03:48,194 --> 00:03:51,830
Es un sujeto que pasó por encima
de su propio tío para tomar el trono.

30
00:03:51,831 --> 00:03:53,765
El hermano de su padre.

31
00:03:53,766 --> 00:03:56,001
- Por favor, ¿eh?
- Estoy avergonzado.

32
00:03:56,002 --> 00:03:58,203
Dejé que viniera al hospital
la última Navidad...

33
00:03:58,204 --> 00:04:00,605
y tomé su maldita mano
gorda en amistad.

34
00:04:00,606 --> 00:04:02,774
Philly, tuviste
un ataque al corazón.

35
00:04:02,775 --> 00:04:06,478
Escúchame. Allá hacen a
cualquiera y a quienquiera.

36
00:04:06,479 --> 00:04:09,014
Y la forma en que lo hacen
está todo para el demonio.

37
00:04:09,015 --> 00:04:11,116
A los tipos no les
cortan el dedo.

38
00:04:11,117 --> 00:04:12,951
No hay espada y
pistola en la mesa.

39
00:04:12,952 --> 00:04:14,820
- Phil.
- No, Alb.

40
00:04:14,821 --> 00:04:17,556
O tiene significado
o no lo tiene.

41
00:04:17,557 --> 00:04:21,293
Y el asunto de Vito...
el tipo apaña a un gusano.

44
00:04:30,737 --> 00:04:33,171
No hay mendrugos
en mi cuaderno de recortes.

45
00:04:36,576 --> 00:04:38,645
Háganlo.

46
00:04:50,322 --> 00:04:53,392
Me gusta la manera que ella
jugó ayer al básquetbol.

47
00:04:53,393 --> 00:04:55,694
Casi tengo mi primera
erección luego de un mes.

48
00:04:55,695 --> 00:04:59,431
Jesus, ¿cuál es el significado
de tiempo tranquilo por aquí?

49
00:05:16,816 --> 00:05:19,351
- ¿Rhiannon?
- ¿A.J.?

50
00:05:19,352 --> 00:05:21,653
Jesús.

51
00:05:24,857 --> 00:05:27,626
¿Qué haces aquí?

52
00:05:28,227 --> 00:05:29,728
Tú primero.

53
00:05:29,929 --> 00:05:32,964
Problemas de alimentación,
depresión.

54
00:05:32,965 --> 00:05:35,367
- ¿Sigues con Hernan?
- Es un cretino.

55
00:05:35,368 --> 00:05:38,103
Lo encontré haciéndoselo a mi prima
con los dedos en el elevador de ski.

56
00:05:38,104 --> 00:05:40,105
Pues, alguien me contó
que estabas modelando.

57
00:05:40,106 --> 00:05:42,107
Sí, supongo.

58
00:05:42,108 --> 00:05:44,142
Firmé contrato con Elite.

59
00:05:44,143 --> 00:05:46,812
De modo que Ud. diría que él
está respondiendo bien a la terapia.

60
00:05:46,813 --> 00:05:49,848
Bueno, no hacemos
terapia tradicional por sí sola.

61
00:05:49,849 --> 00:05:52,985
Los jóvenes en crisis generalmente
necesitan un ambiente tranquilo,...

62
00:05:52,986 --> 00:05:54,386
sin sobresaltos.

63
00:05:55,187 --> 00:05:57,889
¿Quiere esto? O puedo
enviarlo por correo.

64
00:06:03,730 --> 00:06:05,764
Solo una semana más
de esto.

65
00:06:07,433 --> 00:06:09,434
Demonios,
$2.200 por día.

66
00:06:36,195 --> 00:06:38,930
Capicola, provolone...

67
00:06:38,931 --> 00:06:41,367
- y pimientos a la vinagreta.
- Enseguida.

68
00:06:53,212 --> 00:06:55,781
¿Puedes creer este
maldito clima?

69
00:06:56,382 --> 00:06:59,785
Fin de los tiempos, ¿eh?
Listo para que te lleven.

70
00:07:01,286 --> 00:07:03,322
¿Cómo anda
el antierrorismo?

71
00:07:03,323 --> 00:07:06,925
Genial si no te gusta dormir,
comer o ver a tus hijos.

72
00:07:11,097 --> 00:07:13,966
Escucha, esos árabes
del Bing...

73
00:07:14,267 --> 00:07:15,467
Déjame preguntarte
la verdad.

74
00:07:15,468 --> 00:07:17,803
Están en Jordania, ¿verdad?,
¿pasándola realmente mal?

75
00:07:19,105 --> 00:07:20,839
¿No me vas a contar?

76
00:07:20,840 --> 00:07:23,008
No estoy realmente seguro.
Hasta donde sabemos,...

77
00:07:23,009 --> 00:07:25,444
puede que sean inofensivos
vendedores de pistacho.

78
00:07:25,645 --> 00:07:28,981
No te salgas tanto de tu lugar.
Eres un muchacho grande, Tony.

79
00:07:28,982 --> 00:07:32,217
Sabes, en la Segunda Guerra Mundial,
tu agrupación protegió...

80
00:07:32,218 --> 00:07:34,219
el atracadero de la Armada
en Brooklyn.

81
00:07:34,220 --> 00:07:36,321
¿Crees tú que Roosevelt
le dijo a Vito Genovese...

82
00:07:36,322 --> 00:07:39,391
- dónde estaba escondido Hitler?
- Que te parta un rayo.

83
00:07:51,804 --> 00:07:54,373
Tony, Tony, espera.

84
00:07:54,574 --> 00:07:56,241
Tony.

85
00:07:56,842 --> 00:07:58,243
¿Qué?

86
00:07:58,244 --> 00:08:02,014
Mira, aprecio lo que hiciste
al darnos esos nombres.

87
00:08:02,015 --> 00:08:04,850
De hecho, he estado
sentado aquí pensando...

88
00:08:07,486 --> 00:08:10,155
¿Recuerdas ese asunto que te conté
acerca de lo que iba a suceder...

89
00:08:10,156 --> 00:08:12,758
hace como un año,
vuestro problema con Brooklyn?

90
00:08:14,593 --> 00:08:16,628
Otra vez está en marcha
posiblemente.

91
00:08:17,597 --> 00:08:20,133
Tú, tal vez personas
cercanas a tí.

92
00:08:21,034 --> 00:08:23,035
Si fuera realmente sólido, hubieras
sido advertido oficialmente...

93
00:08:23,036 --> 00:08:25,370
por la oficina de Newark,
pero mi colega en Brooklyn,...

94
00:08:25,371 --> 00:08:27,973
aquel con
el colaborador,...

95
00:08:27,974 --> 00:08:30,142
el soplón da a entender que las ruedas
han sido puestas en movimiento.

96
00:08:30,243 --> 00:08:31,810
Da a entender.

97
00:08:49,262 --> 00:08:51,297
¿Dónde demonios
has estado?

98
00:08:52,098 --> 00:08:54,333
Krista se cayó de
sus zapatos anoche.

99
00:08:54,334 --> 00:08:56,335
Tuvimos que llamar
una ambulancia.

100
00:08:57,437 --> 00:08:59,805
Tenía algunos asuntos
que debía atender.

101
00:09:02,175 --> 00:09:04,210
Vas a querer
dar un resoplido.

102
00:09:05,111 --> 00:09:07,312
Vamos, acabo de terminar
mi emparedado polaco.

103
00:09:07,413 --> 00:09:09,414
Tómalo.

104
00:09:12,285 --> 00:09:14,720
Burt Gervasi,
está muerto.

105
00:09:16,421 --> 00:09:17,723
¿Qué sucedió?

106
00:09:17,724 --> 00:09:20,058
No quería sobrecargarte
con A.J. en el hospital.

107
00:09:20,059 --> 00:09:22,096
No quiero oirlo.

108
00:09:22,897 --> 00:09:23,897
Dime.

109
00:09:24,097 --> 00:09:25,764
Burt me hizo saber
la otra noche...

110
00:09:25,765 --> 00:09:29,001
que ha estado jugando a
dos puntas con Nueva York.

111
00:09:29,002 --> 00:09:31,770
- ¿Burt?
- Se adoptaron medidas.

112
00:09:37,176 --> 00:09:39,444
Burt no hablaba
solamente por él.

113
00:09:39,445 --> 00:09:41,046
Los muchachos están siendo
fuertemente presionados...

114
00:09:41,047 --> 00:09:42,781
para inclinarlos hacia
nueva gerencia.

115
00:09:43,282 --> 00:09:45,183
Pensaron que tú
participarías.

116
00:09:45,184 --> 00:09:47,519
Y tuvo una respuesta.

117
00:09:52,959 --> 00:09:56,828
Mi esperanza es que tal vez
ahora Phil entienda el mensaje.

118
00:09:56,829 --> 00:10:00,732
- Sabes, podemos arreglar esto hablando.
- ¿Hablando?

119
00:10:09,241 --> 00:10:11,943
Hablamos de Phil.

120
00:10:12,944 --> 00:10:14,613
Atacaremos primero.

121
00:10:17,417 --> 00:10:20,552
Y todo esto encaja con otra información
que obtuve que este malnacido...

122
00:10:20,553 --> 00:10:22,421
ya me tiene en la mira.

123
00:10:22,422 --> 00:10:25,257
Es una gran movida.

124
00:10:26,258 --> 00:10:28,093
Entonces...

125
00:10:28,494 --> 00:10:30,496
Buda.

126
00:10:30,897 --> 00:10:33,598
Cuando te dejó clavado
con la cuenta de Vito Jr.,...

127
00:10:33,599 --> 00:10:35,734
dije que lo
dejaras pasar.

128
00:10:35,735 --> 00:10:38,670
Obviamente, la verdad es,
con un desgraciado como Phil,...

129
00:10:38,671 --> 00:10:40,272
apaciguar no funciona.

130
00:10:46,412 --> 00:10:48,280
Oh, sí.

131
00:10:55,286 --> 00:10:58,162
DEPILACION Y
SALON DE BELLEZA

132
00:11:04,172 --> 00:11:06,170
ABIERTO

133
00:11:13,740 --> 00:11:16,408
Tres asesinatos dentro de un
ajustado margen de tiempo,...

134
00:11:16,409 --> 00:11:19,711
24 horas, de manera que no
puedan contraatacar.

135
00:11:19,712 --> 00:11:21,447
Los tres sujetos
más importantes.

136
00:11:21,448 --> 00:11:23,548
- ¿Paulie Gaultieri?
- No, gerencia.

137
00:11:23,549 --> 00:11:25,984
Tony Soprano,
obviamente,...

138
00:11:25,985 --> 00:11:29,755
más Silvio Dante y nos
parece Bobby Baccalieri.

139
00:11:29,756 --> 00:11:31,323
¿Ese mortadela
es número tres?

140
00:11:31,324 --> 00:11:33,392
Solía ser el chofer
de Junior Soprano.

141
00:11:33,393 --> 00:11:37,195
Y tú solías vender impresoras láser
en la parte de atrás de tu Crown Vic.

142
00:11:45,071 --> 00:11:47,973
- Realmente dormiste.
- Sí.

143
00:11:47,974 --> 00:11:49,675
No estaba dormido.

144
00:11:49,676 --> 00:11:52,411
¿Quieres un poco de avena?
Haré un poco.

145
00:11:52,412 --> 00:11:54,546
¿Quieres la instantánea o la
verdadera? Tengo mitad y mitad.

146
00:11:54,547 --> 00:11:56,615
No encuentro
mi cinturón.

147
00:11:56,616 --> 00:11:59,518
Debe andar
por ahí.

148
00:11:59,919 --> 00:12:01,753
¿Qué?
Lo escondiste.

149
00:12:05,324 --> 00:12:06,825
Haré la verdadera.

150
00:12:06,826 --> 00:12:08,960
- ¿Me avisas cuando esté lista?
- Seguro.

151
00:12:17,603 --> 00:12:19,505
<i>Sabes, mi juego
se ha puesto...</i>

152
00:12:23,343 --> 00:12:26,345
<i>Código seis. Tengo
una baja. Está grave.</i>

153
00:12:26,546 --> 00:12:28,180
<i>En respuesta,...</i>

154
00:12:28,181 --> 00:12:30,716
<i>los insurgentes lanzan
una ola devastadora...</i>

155
00:12:30,717 --> 00:12:32,651
<i>de artefactos
explosivos improvisados...</i>

156
00:12:32,652 --> 00:12:34,888
<i>y atacantes suicidas.</i>

157
00:12:36,389 --> 00:12:39,124
<i>¿A quién le dieron?
¿Tuviste contacto con ellos?</i>

158
00:12:39,125 --> 00:12:42,728
<i>En una pequeña
pero letal carretera...</i>

159
00:12:42,729 --> 00:12:44,563
<i>¿Quién es el
artillero ahí?</i>

160
00:12:51,570 --> 00:12:52,837
Anthony.

161
00:12:54,107 --> 00:12:56,341
Respecto a nuestro amigo
con el cabello gris...

162
00:12:56,342 --> 00:12:58,210
pensé en ello.
Quiero que llames a Italia,...

163
00:12:58,211 --> 00:13:00,445
que vengan
algunos primos.

164
00:13:03,383 --> 00:13:05,517
¿Quién quieres
que se ocupe?

165
00:13:09,154 --> 00:13:10,288
Entendido.

166
00:13:10,289 --> 00:13:12,557
Tengo que conseguir neumáticos
para el coche de Carmela.

167
00:13:16,796 --> 00:13:18,830
El vino es asombroso.

168
00:13:18,831 --> 00:13:22,167
Jennifer es nuestra experta
residente en vino italiano.

169
00:13:22,168 --> 00:13:25,137
¿Megan aún está en Praga,
Stace?

170
00:13:25,138 --> 00:13:28,573
Jesús, su vida amorosa. La chica
con la que estuvo, Cecily,...

171
00:13:28,574 --> 00:13:32,377
ahora mantiene una tórrida
relación de lápiz y papel...

172
00:13:32,378 --> 00:13:34,646
con un asaltante a
mano armada en Attica.

173
00:13:34,647 --> 00:13:36,515
¿Qué es esta fascinación
con criminales?

174
00:13:36,516 --> 00:13:38,750
Fantasía de rescate. Creen
que pueden enmendarlos.

175
00:13:38,751 --> 00:13:40,585
Me preocupa Cecily.

176
00:13:40,586 --> 00:13:44,022
Así que busqué por Internet nuevo material
sobre personalidades sociopáticas.

177
00:13:44,023 --> 00:13:46,925
Aparentemente,
la cura de hablar...

178
00:13:46,926 --> 00:13:48,927
de hecho los ayuda a
volverse mejores criminales.

179
00:13:49,328 --> 00:13:50,862
Fue fascinante.

180
00:13:50,863 --> 00:13:54,933
El estudio era
de Yochelson y Samenow.

181
00:13:55,334 --> 00:13:58,770
Cada tanto
aparecen estudios.

182
00:13:58,771 --> 00:14:01,306
Este otro, creo que
era Robert Hare,...

183
00:14:01,307 --> 00:14:03,108
sugería que
los sociópatas...

184
00:14:03,109 --> 00:14:05,110
de hecho muy
sueltos de lengua...

185
00:14:05,111 --> 00:14:08,547
se enfrascan en cuestiones
centrales, como madre, familia.

186
00:14:08,548 --> 00:14:10,549
Me parece recordar eso
de la residencia.

187
00:14:10,550 --> 00:14:12,551
Yo también,
y he leído a Hare,...

188
00:14:12,552 --> 00:14:15,020
pero ¿quién es
un verdadero sociópata?

189
00:14:16,021 --> 00:14:18,290
Tuve un sujeto
en el asilo estatal,...

190
00:14:18,291 --> 00:14:21,160
Un envenenador.
Incluso imitan la empatía.

191
00:14:21,461 --> 00:14:23,729
Lloriquean y lagrimean.

192
00:14:23,930 --> 00:14:26,131
¿Tú la convenciste
para hacer esto?

193
00:14:26,132 --> 00:14:28,134
¿Mencionó este estudio
por mera casualidad?

194
00:14:28,235 --> 00:14:31,903
- ¿Quién? ¿Yo?
- ¿Todo en orden por allá?

195
00:14:31,904 --> 00:14:33,739
No lo sé.

196
00:14:33,740 --> 00:14:36,475
Es un estudio.
Material para pensar.

197
00:14:36,476 --> 00:14:38,076
Nos está poniendo al descubierto.

198
00:14:38,077 --> 00:14:41,313
Simplemente no puedes resistir
frotármelo en la cara.

199
00:14:41,314 --> 00:14:43,615
Me parece que deberíamos
cambiar de tema.

200
00:14:43,716 --> 00:14:46,485
Solo sugería que
reevaluaras tu trabajo...

201
00:14:46,486 --> 00:14:49,688
con Panza de Plomo o te prepararas
a lidiar con consecuencias morales...

202
00:14:49,689 --> 00:14:51,757
y posiblemente legales.

203
00:14:51,758 --> 00:14:54,626
- ¿Panza de Plomo?
- ¿Quién es ese? Vamos.

204
00:14:54,627 --> 00:14:57,796
La respuesta es una
cantora de ópera...

205
00:14:57,797 --> 00:14:59,798
y gángster...

206
00:15:01,868 --> 00:15:03,969
¡Elliot!

207
00:15:03,970 --> 00:15:06,204
Soprano.

208
00:15:06,205 --> 00:15:09,841
- ¿Tony Soprano? ¿Es tu paciente?
- Caramba.

209
00:15:09,842 --> 00:15:12,511
- Eso es bien chévere.
- Jesús Cristo, Elliot.

210
00:15:12,512 --> 00:15:14,446
Relájate.
Estamos entre amigos.

211
00:15:14,447 --> 00:15:16,048
Somos todos
profesionales.

212
00:15:20,053 --> 00:15:22,621
Entonces, ¿cuál es tu veredicto
sobre el vino, Jen?

213
00:15:22,622 --> 00:15:24,790
Que todos los italianos
tienen narices grandes.

214
00:15:24,791 --> 00:15:28,460
Si yo hubiera hecho esa broma
sobre otros grupos...

215
00:15:28,461 --> 00:15:30,796
representados
en esta mesa,...

216
00:15:30,797 --> 00:15:32,864
me hubieran llamado
prejuiciosa.

217
00:15:32,865 --> 00:15:35,500
Me refería a los
tintos italianos.

218
00:15:37,504 --> 00:15:40,606
Aun así, debe ser
un trabajo fascinante.

219
00:15:42,207 --> 00:15:44,008
Lo es.

220
00:16:06,332 --> 00:16:08,334
Toma asiento.

221
00:16:09,435 --> 00:16:12,771
- ¿Qué hay?
- Phil Leotardo.

222
00:16:12,772 --> 00:16:16,675
Llamamos a Sicilia.
Vienen desde Nápoles.

223
00:16:16,676 --> 00:16:18,777
Tú contactas al sujeto
para contactar a los sujetos.

224
00:16:18,778 --> 00:16:21,947
Phil va a casa de su amante
todos los viernes por la noche.

225
00:16:21,948 --> 00:16:24,016
- ¿T sabe de esto?
- ¿Qué?

226
00:16:24,217 --> 00:16:27,185
- ¿Qué clase de pregunta es ésa?
- Cuida tu maldita boca.

227
00:16:27,186 --> 00:16:30,622
Mira, oye, oye, oye, oye.
¿Qué te preocupa?

228
00:16:30,623 --> 00:16:32,791
Viví los años 70
muriéndome de miedo...

229
00:16:32,792 --> 00:16:34,993
cuando los Columbos
se nos vinieron encima.

230
00:16:34,994 --> 00:16:37,863
No hay peor malnacido
que Phil Leotardo.

231
00:16:37,864 --> 00:16:40,265
Simplemente quería asegurarme
que alguien sabe...

232
00:16:40,266 --> 00:16:42,768
que podría haber una fila de Cozarelli
de dos kilómetros de largo.

233
00:16:42,969 --> 00:16:46,505
Debidamente notado.
De modo que no hay problema.

234
00:16:51,851 --> 00:16:56,035
LA PERSONALIDAD CRIMINAL
por S.Yochelson y S.E.Samenow

235
00:16:58,547 --> 00:17:00,590
El sentimentalismo del criminal...

236
00:17:00,791 --> 00:17:03,291
se manifiesta en...

237
00:17:03,913 --> 00:17:06,073
compasión por los bebés...

238
00:17:06,274 --> 00:17:08,074
y las mascotas.

239
00:17:10,441 --> 00:17:11,892
El criminal...

240
00:17:11,893 --> 00:17:13,493
usa conocimiento
profundo...

241
00:17:13,494 --> 00:17:14,993
para justificar...

242
00:17:14,994 --> 00:17:16,794
actos atroces.

243
00:17:17,915 --> 00:17:20,239
La terapia ofrece
posibilidades...

244
00:17:20,240 --> 00:17:21,540
para los
no criminales;...

245
00:17:23,640 --> 00:17:26,032
para los criminales,
se convierte...

246
00:17:26,033 --> 00:17:29,833
en otra operación
criminal más.

247
00:17:40,493 --> 00:17:42,094
No te preocupes
por ellos.

248
00:17:42,095 --> 00:17:43,962
Paulie, los sujetos
están afuero.

249
00:17:43,963 --> 00:17:46,598
¿Por qué rayos
hablas tan fuerte?

250
00:17:46,599 --> 00:17:49,435
No hables de esto hasta que
estemos en el mingitorio.

251
00:17:52,939 --> 00:17:54,940
Es todo tuyo.

252
00:18:03,850 --> 00:18:06,284
Acabo de recogerlos
en el aeropuerto.

253
00:18:35,185 --> 00:18:37,223
BISTEC CON PIMIENTO DE
EZPELETA MARINADO

254
00:18:37,224 --> 00:18:39,424
ESTE PIMIENTO PICANTE VASCO PONE EN
ORBITA CUALQUIER BISTEC ASADO

255
00:18:55,668 --> 00:18:58,003
Anthony.

256
00:19:11,117 --> 00:19:13,586
¿Cuánto gana en limpio
en un año por aquí?

257
00:19:14,587 --> 00:19:17,255
No es mi intención fisgonear, Ud. sabe,
simplemente estoy haciendo números.

258
00:19:22,662 --> 00:19:26,198
Pregunto porque
Meadow...

259
00:19:26,199 --> 00:19:28,800
Pues, le conté a Ud. que
ella estaba estudiando medicina.

260
00:19:30,001 --> 00:19:32,204
Pues, ella no va
a ser médica.

261
00:19:33,406 --> 00:19:35,641
Ella nos dijo.

262
00:19:37,443 --> 00:19:39,444
Es un poco triste,
¿no es cierto?

263
00:19:39,445 --> 00:19:41,046
Depende.

264
00:19:41,047 --> 00:19:44,082
Es una bella
profesión,...

265
00:19:44,083 --> 00:19:45,817
atender
bebés enfermos.

266
00:19:45,818 --> 00:19:48,053
¿Su cambio de preferencia
le molesta?

267
00:19:48,054 --> 00:19:51,156
A su madre también,
mucho más que a mí.

268
00:19:51,157 --> 00:19:52,824
Es decir, toda esa
preocupación...

269
00:19:52,825 --> 00:19:55,861
qué colegio privado,
Universidad de Columbia,...

270
00:19:55,862 --> 00:19:58,897
esto y lo otro,
y al final...

271
00:19:58,898 --> 00:20:01,633
se casará, tendrá
un par de chicos...

272
00:20:01,634 --> 00:20:03,769
luego qué, ¿un par de años
en la fuerza de trabajo?

273
00:20:03,770 --> 00:20:07,005
- Yo sigo trabajando.
- Sí, pero Ud. está divorciada.

274
00:20:08,541 --> 00:20:11,544
Derecho penal,
eso está estudiando ella.

275
00:20:12,245 --> 00:20:15,247
Y le dije a Carmela
que no es el fin del mundo.

276
00:20:17,383 --> 00:20:19,117
A ella le interesan...

277
00:20:20,018 --> 00:20:21,787
los derechos civiles...

278
00:20:21,788 --> 00:20:24,623
musulmanes y negros...

279
00:20:25,224 --> 00:20:27,393
y eso y unas monedas.

280
00:20:28,928 --> 00:20:31,730
Con fortuna, terminará
en un gran estudio de abogados...

281
00:20:32,965 --> 00:20:35,501
delitos de cuello blanco.

282
00:20:37,837 --> 00:20:39,905
Es sólo que, Ud. sabe,...

283
00:20:40,506 --> 00:20:42,507
Doctora Soprano.

284
00:20:44,811 --> 00:20:46,545
Suena agradable.

285
00:20:50,917 --> 00:20:53,118
Los padres de Ud. deben
estar muy orgullosos.

286
00:20:53,119 --> 00:20:54,820
Supongo.

287
00:20:54,821 --> 00:20:57,622
Fíjese todas las personas
como yo que Ud. ha ayudado.

288
00:20:58,591 --> 00:21:00,726
Con todo el sufrimiento
que hay en este mundo,...

289
00:21:00,727 --> 00:21:02,327
Ud. ha hecho algo
importante...

290
00:21:05,330 --> 00:21:08,133
como esas personas...

291
00:21:08,134 --> 00:21:10,202
que intentan
ayudar a mi hijo.

292
00:21:12,905 --> 00:21:15,307
Dios los bendiga.

293
00:21:16,909 --> 00:21:18,744
$2.000 por día
en ese sitio,...

294
00:21:18,745 --> 00:21:21,146
pero si ayuda...

295
00:21:21,147 --> 00:21:23,315
Y como Ud. sabe, mi seguro
del sindicato de plomeros...

296
00:21:23,316 --> 00:21:26,318
solo cubre 10% de
problemas mentales.

297
00:21:29,922 --> 00:21:31,990
Él realmente sufre...

298
00:21:31,991 --> 00:21:34,159
A.J.

299
00:21:34,560 --> 00:21:36,161
¿Y Ud.?

300
00:21:36,462 --> 00:21:38,430
Aunque, tal vez,
Ud. sabe...

301
00:21:38,431 --> 00:21:40,566
¿Sabe qué? Olvide su sufrimiento.
Tal vez yo simplemente debería...

302
00:21:40,567 --> 00:21:42,634
¿Meterle el zapato
por el trasero?

303
00:21:43,035 --> 00:21:45,671
Sí sí, francamente.

304
00:21:47,740 --> 00:21:49,674
Pues, hablamos
al respecto.

305
00:21:49,875 --> 00:21:51,843
Ni lo mencionamos.

306
00:21:52,044 --> 00:21:53,345
¿Eh?

307
00:21:54,381 --> 00:21:56,782
- Como sea, Carmela...
- Fue indulgente con él.

308
00:21:56,783 --> 00:21:59,618
- Mi viejo...
- ¿Es Ud. un claro ejemplo...

309
00:21:59,619 --> 00:22:02,688
de la enorme colección de los
despistados y holgazanes...

310
00:22:02,689 --> 00:22:05,457
que deben ser alojados
en su intestino grueso?

311
00:22:05,458 --> 00:22:07,627
¿Cuál es su problema?

312
00:22:07,928 --> 00:22:10,729
¿Es porque dije que
estaba divorciada?

313
00:22:10,830 --> 00:22:12,832
Ud. decía.

314
00:22:13,433 --> 00:22:15,401
Es mi único hijo.

315
00:22:15,502 --> 00:22:19,071
Él es joven. En general
se sobreponen a esto.

316
00:22:19,172 --> 00:22:22,274
Pero yo hace años que estoy deprimido.
¿Y si no se sobrepone?

317
00:22:22,275 --> 00:22:24,443
De manera que el muchacho
que nunca se preocupó`..

318
00:22:24,444 --> 00:22:26,478
por nada...

319
00:22:26,479 --> 00:22:29,214
ahora se preocupa
por demasiado.

320
00:22:29,215 --> 00:22:31,216
Sí, supongo.

321
00:22:31,217 --> 00:22:34,219
Y la hija, como
todas las hembras,...

322
00:22:34,220 --> 00:22:37,023
finalmente decepciona
de alguna manera.

323
00:22:37,224 --> 00:22:39,525
- Yo no dije eso.
- Oh.

324
00:22:39,626 --> 00:22:41,627
¿Por qué ese tono?

325
00:22:42,228 --> 00:22:44,629
Suena como si Ud.
estuviera contenta...

326
00:22:44,630 --> 00:22:46,565
que estoy pasando
un mal rato.

327
00:22:46,566 --> 00:22:49,334
Tal vez Ud. está proyectando
sentimientos hostiles.

328
00:22:49,335 --> 00:22:52,804
Patrañas. Si tuviéramos
repetición instantánea,...

329
00:22:52,805 --> 00:22:54,506
Ud. lo vería en
dos segundos.

330
00:22:54,507 --> 00:22:56,642
Pues, no tenemos
repetición instantánea.

331
00:22:56,643 --> 00:22:59,945
Ya lo sé. Jesús Cristo, Ud.
suena como mi maldita esposa.

332
00:22:59,946 --> 00:23:02,748
- Su "maldita esposa".
- Ud. sabe a lo que me refiero.

333
00:23:02,749 --> 00:23:05,417
La revista "Departures"
ahí fuera,...

334
00:23:05,418 --> 00:23:07,419
¿acaso se detuvo a pensar...

335
00:23:07,420 --> 00:23:10,756
que alguien podría
querer leerla...

336
00:23:10,757 --> 00:23:14,760
- antes que Ud. arrancara la página entera?
- ¿Qué?

337
00:23:14,761 --> 00:23:17,863
No es la primera vez que Ud.
desfigura mi material de lectura.

338
00:23:18,364 --> 00:23:20,165
Ud. me vio, ¿eh?

339
00:23:20,766 --> 00:23:23,101
Las personas arrancan cosas
de sus revistas todo el tiempo.

340
00:23:23,102 --> 00:23:25,371
Son un desastre.
Trato de leerlas.

341
00:23:25,472 --> 00:23:27,573
No creo que
pueda ayudarle.

342
00:23:27,674 --> 00:23:29,475
Bueno, cámbielas.
Traiga nuevo material.

343
00:23:29,476 --> 00:23:31,343
Quiero decir,
terapéuticamente.

344
00:23:34,180 --> 00:23:37,049
¿De qué habla?

345
00:23:37,450 --> 00:23:40,652
Solo perdí tres citas desde que
tuvimos ese conversación íntima.

346
00:23:40,753 --> 00:23:43,488
La nueva gran cosa
en estos días se llama...

347
00:23:43,489 --> 00:23:45,824
"terapia psicodinámica"...

348
00:23:45,825 --> 00:23:48,226
- combinada con Anafranil.
- ¿Quién?

349
00:23:48,327 --> 00:23:50,829
Una medicación. Hay un
médico en Bloomfield...

350
00:23:50,830 --> 00:23:52,264
al que Ud. podría ver.

351
00:23:52,265 --> 00:23:54,633
Momento, momento,
está bien.

352
00:23:54,834 --> 00:23:56,902
¿Que rayos es esto?

353
00:23:56,903 --> 00:23:58,737
¿Está echándome...

354
00:23:58,738 --> 00:24:01,540
porque desfiguré su
revista "Departures"?

355
00:24:01,541 --> 00:24:04,977
Le estoy dando mi meditada
opinión médica.

356
00:24:04,978 --> 00:24:07,479
De acuerdo, debería
haberle pedido...

357
00:24:07,480 --> 00:24:09,748
la receta del bistec.

358
00:24:11,250 --> 00:24:14,553
Y perderme sesiones, por desgracia,
es parte de mi condición.

359
00:24:14,554 --> 00:24:17,556
¿Qué sabe Ud. acerca
de su condición?

360
00:24:17,557 --> 00:24:20,993
Ud. se pierde citas porque
no le importan un bledo...

361
00:24:20,994 --> 00:24:23,528
los compromisos,
lo que yo hago,...

362
00:24:23,529 --> 00:24:27,132
el cúmulo de trabajo
que ha requerido...

363
00:24:27,133 --> 00:24:29,434
construir
esta ciencia.

364
00:24:33,239 --> 00:24:36,208
Adelante, dígame otra vez
que sueno como su esposa.

365
00:24:36,509 --> 00:24:38,676
Pues, a quien le
quepa el sayo...

366
00:24:39,779 --> 00:24:42,781
Estamos progresando.
Han sido siete años.

367
00:24:43,682 --> 00:24:46,051
¿Quiere algunos nombres?

368
00:24:46,652 --> 00:24:48,520
De acuerdo, escuche,
voy a decirle algo...

369
00:24:48,521 --> 00:24:50,222
y a Ud. no le
va a gustar,...

370
00:24:50,223 --> 00:24:52,791
- pero podemos decir lo que sea aquí, ¿no?
- ¡Adelante!

371
00:24:54,727 --> 00:24:56,695
Le adjudico
todo esto...

372
00:24:56,696 --> 00:24:59,698
a situaciones de
menopausia femenina.

373
00:24:59,999 --> 00:25:02,067
Ud. no es
mi ginecólogo.

374
00:25:02,168 --> 00:25:05,470
Pues, no necesitas un ginecólogo
para saber hacia dónde sopla el viento.

375
00:25:12,846 --> 00:25:15,647
Espere un minuto,...

376
00:25:15,948 --> 00:25:17,649
¿me está diciendo...

377
00:25:17,650 --> 00:25:19,484
luego de todo
este tiempo,...

378
00:25:19,485 --> 00:25:22,954
luego de todo lo que
compartimos aquí...

379
00:25:22,955 --> 00:25:26,058
que me está dejando a la deriva
en cuanto mi hijo salió del hospital...

380
00:25:26,059 --> 00:25:27,993
por intentar
suicidarse?

381
00:25:30,463 --> 00:25:32,731
Ya que Ud.
está en crisis,...

382
00:25:32,732 --> 00:25:34,666
no quiero desperdiciar
su tiempo.

383
00:25:36,336 --> 00:25:39,304
Voy a ser
muy honesto.

384
00:25:39,305 --> 00:25:40,906
Como médico,...

385
00:25:40,907 --> 00:25:43,475
yo creo que lo que Ud.
está haciendo es inmoral.

386
00:27:00,117 --> 00:27:01,453
Sí.

387
00:27:01,554 --> 00:27:03,588
DHL.

388
00:27:03,589 --> 00:27:06,224
- ¿Quién?
- Paqueta.

389
00:27:06,225 --> 00:27:09,661
DHL Express
para el señor Philip.

390
00:27:11,331 --> 00:27:13,065
Para firmo.

391
00:27:18,138 --> 00:27:19,771
Para firma.

392
00:27:24,552 --> 00:27:26,225
¿Qué haces?

393
00:27:29,235 --> 00:27:30,734
¡Papá, papá!

394
00:27:33,318 --> 00:27:35,111
¡Papi, me dispararon!

395
00:28:00,213 --> 00:28:03,081
- Sí.
- Está hecho. Nos vamos.

396
00:28:03,082 --> 00:28:04,082
De acuerdo.

397
00:28:04,541 --> 00:28:08,221
La mujer se interpuso.
Nos encargamos de ella.

398
00:28:09,021 --> 00:28:10,361
Mierda. ¿Quién?

399
00:28:10,362 --> 00:28:11,362
La hija.

400
00:28:11,504 --> 00:28:14,620
¿La hija?
¿Qué hacía ella ahí?

401
00:28:14,921 --> 00:28:17,621
Vive ahí, supongo.

402
00:28:18,122 --> 00:28:19,122
¿Qué?

403
00:28:19,123 --> 00:28:21,223
Lo llamaba papi.

404
00:28:22,124 --> 00:28:23,124
De acuerdo.

405
00:28:23,525 --> 00:28:27,325
Dime, ¿tu amigo
habla ucraniano?

406
00:28:27,326 --> 00:28:28,326
¿Ucraniano?

407
00:28:28,927 --> 00:28:30,527
Hablaban ucraniano.

408
00:28:30,528 --> 00:28:33,928
Lo sé porque mi sobrina
se casó con un tipo de ahí.

409
00:28:34,680 --> 00:28:36,894
De acuerdo.
Que tengan buen viaje.

410
00:28:50,997 --> 00:28:53,298
- Sí.
- Está hecho.

411
00:28:53,299 --> 00:28:55,367
Creo que el interés amoroso
se interpuso, sin embargo.

412
00:28:56,468 --> 00:28:58,704
<i>No pudo evitarse,
aparentemente.</i>

413
00:28:58,705 --> 00:29:01,540
<i>¿Alguna vez viste a Phil
con la amante?</i>

414
00:29:01,541 --> 00:29:03,509
Una vez tal vez.
¿Por qué?

415
00:29:03,510 --> 00:29:05,344
¿Pudo hablarle a ella
en ucraniano?

416
00:29:05,345 --> 00:29:07,813
¿Ucraniano?
¿Yo qué sé?

417
00:29:09,816 --> 00:29:11,650
Debo irme.

418
00:29:18,057 --> 00:29:20,359
Paulie, está hecho.

419
00:29:32,071 --> 00:29:35,240
Escucha, yo...

420
00:29:35,241 --> 00:29:37,809
dejé terapia.

421
00:29:37,810 --> 00:29:41,079
Y esta vez,
no volveré.

422
00:29:43,182 --> 00:29:46,351
Excepto por esa pequeña mejora
cuando te dispararon,...

423
00:29:46,352 --> 00:29:48,353
no te estaba haciendo
mucho bien de todas formas.

424
00:29:49,654 --> 00:29:51,523
Aquí vamos.

425
00:29:51,824 --> 00:29:54,459
- Hola, forasteros, ¿cómo están?
- ¿Cómo estás?

426
00:29:54,460 --> 00:29:57,429
- Bien, nada mal.
- Bien bien.

427
00:29:57,430 --> 00:29:58,930
Helos aquí.

428
00:29:58,931 --> 00:30:01,533
Así que Meadow
estuvo aquí...

429
00:30:01,534 --> 00:30:03,035
con Patrick Parisi.

430
00:30:03,036 --> 00:30:05,370
- Sí.
- Estamos muy contentos.

431
00:30:05,371 --> 00:30:07,205
Muy contentos.

432
00:30:07,206 --> 00:30:09,441
¿Es cierto lo que dijo?
¿Renuncia a medicina?

433
00:30:09,442 --> 00:30:13,278
Sí, gracias a Dios.
Estamos tan aliviados.

434
00:30:13,279 --> 00:30:15,614
Sabéis, con el SIDA
y...

435
00:30:15,615 --> 00:30:17,182
No es solamente eso.

436
00:30:17,183 --> 00:30:19,918
No conozco a un solo médico
que aconseje a sus hijos...

437
00:30:19,919 --> 00:30:23,255
a dedicarse a medicina.
Entre las compañías de seguro...

438
00:30:23,256 --> 00:30:24,723
encima suyo,...

439
00:30:24,724 --> 00:30:26,758
los hospitales
recortando...

440
00:30:26,959 --> 00:30:28,927
Igual, hubiera sido
buena, Meadow.

441
00:30:28,928 --> 00:30:31,563
Siempre intelectualmente curiosa,
incluso cuando era muy pequeña.

442
00:30:31,664 --> 00:30:34,066
Pero, ¿acaso la compasión
le surge naturalmente?

443
00:30:34,067 --> 00:30:36,868
¿La paciencia?
No estoy tan segura.

444
00:30:36,869 --> 00:30:38,570
¿De qué hablas?

445
00:30:38,571 --> 00:30:40,105
Entonces, ¿qué
hará ella ahora?

446
00:30:40,106 --> 00:30:42,574
- Pues...
- Derecho.

447
00:30:42,575 --> 00:30:45,043
- ¡Oh!
- Derecho constitucional.

448
00:30:45,044 --> 00:30:47,379
- ¡Oh!
- Oh, qué bien.

449
00:30:47,380 --> 00:30:49,881
¿Y A.J.?
¿Cómo anda?

450
00:30:49,882 --> 00:30:52,451
- Está bien. Está bien.
- Bien.

451
00:30:55,755 --> 00:30:58,223
Ton, ¿sabes quién
está aquí hoy?

452
00:30:58,224 --> 00:30:59,825
"Mangenius".

453
00:31:01,660 --> 00:31:04,296
Es el entrenador
de los Jets, cariño.

454
00:31:04,297 --> 00:31:07,532
- Debería ir a saludar.
- De acuerdo.

455
00:31:11,070 --> 00:31:13,205
¿Así que Meadow
y Patrick Parisi?

456
00:31:15,575 --> 00:31:17,409
Un poco incómodo,
tal vez.

457
00:31:18,545 --> 00:31:21,480
Patsy aún trabaja para Tony.
Es un subordinado.

458
00:31:21,481 --> 00:31:25,317
Las flechas de Cupido
impactan, ¿sabes?

459
00:31:25,318 --> 00:31:27,686
Les enviaré unos limoncellos
para celebrar.

460
00:31:27,687 --> 00:31:29,888
Genial.

461
00:31:39,932 --> 00:31:41,967
¿No atiendes tu
maldito teléfono?

462
00:31:41,968 --> 00:31:44,870
- Te llamé 50 veces anoche.
- Nah, los apagamos.

463
00:31:44,871 --> 00:31:47,205
Gab estaba muy descompuesta
por algo que comió.

464
00:31:49,776 --> 00:31:53,211
Puedes pasar la noticia arriba.
El ganso gris se ha ido.

465
00:31:53,212 --> 00:31:56,281
- Bien.
- Parece que también hubo que liquidar a la amante.

466
00:31:56,282 --> 00:31:58,617
Pero yo digo,
¿a quién le importa?

467
00:31:58,618 --> 00:32:02,120
¿Recuerdas esa maldita escena de ebriedad
que generó en la fiesta de "Jersey boys"?

468
00:32:02,121 --> 00:32:04,289
De hecho, me sentí mal
por Phil.

469
00:32:07,693 --> 00:32:09,327
¿Qué sucede?

470
00:32:09,328 --> 00:32:11,029
Cada vez que pienso
en esa maldita obra,...

471
00:32:11,030 --> 00:32:13,298
me viene a la mente
mamá muriendo sola...

472
00:32:13,299 --> 00:32:16,101
como un perro
en ese autobús.

473
00:32:16,402 --> 00:32:19,204
Harás a alguien feliz
con estas noticias hoy.

474
00:32:19,805 --> 00:32:22,641
Creo que pediré
vacaciones.

475
00:32:22,642 --> 00:32:26,144
Oigan, ¿a quién se
parece éste? Miren.

476
00:32:28,188 --> 00:32:30,234
DOBLE ASESINATO
UCRANIANO EN QUEENS

477
00:32:30,235 --> 00:32:32,635
PAPA E HIJA DEJAN ENTRAR A CASA
A MALVIVIENTE, DICEN LOS POLIS

478
00:32:47,934 --> 00:32:51,403
No llores. Las niñitas buenas
no lloran. Los bebés lloran.

479
00:32:53,939 --> 00:32:55,774
Hola.

480
00:32:55,775 --> 00:32:58,577
- ¿Cómo va?
- Bien.

481
00:32:58,578 --> 00:33:01,013
Tengo mi
juego de cartas.

482
00:33:01,014 --> 00:33:03,215
Carm se ofreció
a cuidar a Nica.

483
00:33:04,784 --> 00:33:06,852
Vaciando la piscina, ¿eh?

484
00:33:06,953 --> 00:33:10,122
- Climatizarla cuesta una fortuna.
- Sí.

485
00:33:12,291 --> 00:33:13,892
¿Qué puedo hacer por tí?

486
00:33:13,893 --> 00:33:16,061
Recibí una llamada
de Mario Diaco.

487
00:33:16,062 --> 00:33:18,730
- ¿Quién es ese?
- El contador de tío Jun,...

488
00:33:19,031 --> 00:33:22,001
aquel con la caja de voz artificial,
dice que intenta contactarte...

489
00:33:22,002 --> 00:33:24,070
desde hace
dos semanas.

490
00:33:26,071 --> 00:33:28,874
Tío Jun se ha quedado
finalmente sin dinero.

491
00:33:29,075 --> 00:33:32,177
Creen que tal vez haya
algo por ahí escondido,...

492
00:33:32,178 --> 00:33:33,779
pero él no se acuerda.

493
00:33:35,515 --> 00:33:37,916
Es un maldito pecado,
¿no es así?

494
00:33:39,452 --> 00:33:41,453
Además, con la laringe,
cree que Mario...

495
00:33:41,454 --> 00:33:43,455
es del espacio exterior,
así que...

496
00:33:43,556 --> 00:33:45,524
el resultado es que
ya no puede pagar...

497
00:33:45,525 --> 00:33:47,693
vivir en el
Psiquiátrico Wycoff,...

498
00:33:47,694 --> 00:33:50,228
y lo van a trasladar
a una institución estatal.

499
00:33:52,098 --> 00:33:53,632
Lo sé, Tony,...

500
00:33:53,633 --> 00:33:56,835
pero Jesús, esos malditos
sitios son nidos de serpientes.

501
00:33:56,836 --> 00:33:58,870
Entonces hará
nuevos amigos.

502
00:34:00,940 --> 00:34:02,708
Entiendo.

503
00:34:02,809 --> 00:34:04,643
¿Vas a sacarlo
pagando fianza?

504
00:34:04,644 --> 00:34:07,412
No tenemos esa clase de
dinero. Contribuiríamos.

505
00:34:09,282 --> 00:34:12,351
Bobby siente...

506
00:34:13,052 --> 00:34:14,286
Tú sabes.

507
00:34:17,289 --> 00:34:18,924
Correcto.

508
00:34:23,030 --> 00:34:25,598
Tienes muchas agallas
para venir conmigo.

509
00:34:27,467 --> 00:34:29,702
Y en cuanto a tu esposo,
Janice,...

510
00:34:29,703 --> 00:34:32,771
- "Exilio en la calle principal".
- No digas eso.

511
00:34:32,972 --> 00:34:34,873
Confías en un tipo,
lo cultivas...

512
00:34:34,874 --> 00:34:37,209
¿y para qué?

513
00:34:37,410 --> 00:34:40,012
¿Siente lástima
por Junior?

514
00:34:46,819 --> 00:34:48,820
Tonterías.

515
00:35:01,301 --> 00:35:03,369
Ton, malas noticias.

516
00:35:09,609 --> 00:35:12,611
Paulie dijo que quiere que
sepas que es culpa suya,...

517
00:35:12,612 --> 00:35:14,846
asume toda la
responsabilidad,...

518
00:35:14,847 --> 00:35:17,115
pero que él
no hizo nada.

519
00:35:18,451 --> 00:35:20,786
Mierda.

520
00:35:20,787 --> 00:35:24,289
Sí, nadie,...

521
00:35:24,290 --> 00:35:27,626
y me refiero a nadie, sabe
dónde demonios está Phil,...

522
00:35:27,627 --> 00:35:30,028
hace ya cuatro,
cinco días.

523
00:35:30,029 --> 00:35:32,631
De manera que nunca
lo tuvimos a tiro.

524
00:35:34,934 --> 00:35:37,202
¿Qué hay sobre la
casa en Florida?

525
00:35:37,203 --> 00:35:38,470
Hice que Beans enviara
a alguien a mirar.

526
00:35:38,471 --> 00:35:40,472
La casa está
toda sellada.

527
00:35:40,473 --> 00:35:43,141
Puso todo en su lugar,
avanza hacia nosotros.

528
00:35:43,142 --> 00:35:45,677
Se esconde,
espera.

529
00:35:45,678 --> 00:35:47,980
Irse a tierra,
lo llaman.

530
00:35:48,181 --> 00:35:49,748
¿Quién?

531
00:35:49,749 --> 00:35:51,817
Es una expresión.

532
00:35:54,921 --> 00:35:56,922
Quién sabe qué demonios
tiene planeado exactamente.

533
00:35:56,923 --> 00:36:00,158
Avisa a todos:
ojos en la nuca,...

534
00:36:00,159 --> 00:36:03,662
rompan rutinas, recolecciones,
toda esa porquería.

535
00:36:04,998 --> 00:36:07,833
Les dices a todos.

536
00:36:08,134 --> 00:36:09,835
Entendido.

537
00:36:09,836 --> 00:36:12,738
Mientras tanto, seguimos
intentando. Ponle 20 a Phil.

538
00:36:39,132 --> 00:36:42,234
- Hermoso.
- Nunca ves un Blue Comet...

539
00:36:42,235 --> 00:36:45,470
en ese estado.
Es decir, mira los vagones.

540
00:36:45,471 --> 00:36:48,206
Todas las ventanillas
aún encienden.

541
00:36:48,207 --> 00:36:50,442
Si ese tren aún recorriera
Nueva York a A.C.,...

542
00:36:50,443 --> 00:36:53,612
Atlantic City sería hoy
un lugar muy distinto.

543
00:36:53,613 --> 00:36:56,715
- Mejor clase de personas.
- Supongo.

544
00:36:56,716 --> 00:36:59,418
¿Quién demonios
lo sabe realmente?

545
00:36:59,419 --> 00:37:02,622
Aun así, es agradable
pensarlo.

546
00:37:02,923 --> 00:37:05,624
Imagina viajar en
ese vagón comedor,...

547
00:37:05,625 --> 00:37:07,259
bebiéndote un Negroni.

548
00:37:08,960 --> 00:37:11,329
Ocho mil dólares por el
juego completo, ¿eh?

549
00:37:11,598 --> 00:37:14,066
Hay otras personas
interesadas.

550
00:37:20,840 --> 00:37:22,841
Me lo llevaré.

551
00:37:23,142 --> 00:37:25,143
A tu hijo también
le gustará.

552
00:37:25,144 --> 00:37:27,145
Se ve rápido.

553
00:37:28,514 --> 00:37:30,550
A él no le importa.

554
00:38:16,462 --> 00:38:19,297
- De prisa, por amor de Cristo.
- De acuerdo, espera.

555
00:38:19,298 --> 00:38:22,234
Si voy a trabajar fuera de la
oficina, necesito estas cosas.

556
00:38:22,235 --> 00:38:23,468
¿Quieres ser útil?

557
00:38:23,469 --> 00:38:26,171
Toma las liquidaciones
de las chicas.

558
00:38:26,172 --> 00:38:29,174
Ponlas en una bolsa.
O dámelas a mí.

559
00:38:30,510 --> 00:38:32,511
Vamos.

560
00:38:35,849 --> 00:38:37,650
De acuerdo.

561
00:38:53,366 --> 00:38:54,799
Vámonos.

562
00:38:56,436 --> 00:38:59,205
- Sí, son ellos ahí.
- ¡Maldición!

563
00:39:00,006 --> 00:39:01,740
¿Qué rayos?

564
00:39:25,598 --> 00:39:27,799
Larguémonos
de aquí.

565
00:40:07,173 --> 00:40:09,141
Aguarda aquí.

566
00:40:14,147 --> 00:40:17,916
Melissa encontró una tarjeta de memoria
en mi cartera Prada que no fue impresa.

567
00:40:17,917 --> 00:40:20,352
Dios, ¿te acuerdas lo mentecato
que era este tipo al principio?

568
00:40:20,353 --> 00:40:22,088
Sí.

569
00:40:24,324 --> 00:40:26,325
Necesito hablar contigo.

570
00:40:35,768 --> 00:40:38,537
- ¿Nadie te llamó?
- No. ¿Qué sucede?

571
00:40:39,839 --> 00:40:43,375
Bobby está muerto. Le dispararon.
Sil está en el hospital.

572
00:40:43,376 --> 00:40:45,877
- ¿Qué sucedió?
- Podrían ser varias cosas.

573
00:40:51,251 --> 00:40:53,352
- ¿"Vete de aquí"? ¿De qué hablas?
- Sólo temporariamente,...

574
00:40:53,353 --> 00:40:55,921
- hasta que tengamos la situación bajo control.
- ¿Qué significa eso?

575
00:40:55,922 --> 00:40:58,290
Carm, ayúdame.
No discutas.

576
00:40:58,291 --> 00:41:00,459
- Quieres decir que están detrás de tí.
- Deberíamos separarnos.

577
00:41:00,460 --> 00:41:03,195
Vete con los niños.
Yo estaré en otro lugar.

578
00:41:03,196 --> 00:41:04,830
- ¡Oh Dios mío!
- Ahora mira,...

579
00:41:04,831 --> 00:41:06,865
a las familias no las tocan.
Tú sabes eso, ¿eh?

580
00:41:06,866 --> 00:41:08,734
Simplemente quiero saber...

581
00:41:08,735 --> 00:41:10,769
todas las noches que no estás
sentada aquí fuera en campo abierto.

582
00:41:10,770 --> 00:41:13,338
- ¿A dónde iré? ¿A dónde irás tú?
- La casa que acabas de comprar.

583
00:41:13,339 --> 00:41:15,908
- La venta inmobiliaria... vete ahí.
- Oh, Jesús.

584
00:41:15,909 --> 00:41:18,143
Un hotel entonces.
No tiene importancia.

585
00:41:21,147 --> 00:41:24,082
- De acuerdo.
- ¿Estás bien?

586
00:41:24,083 --> 00:41:25,651
De acuerdo, hay que
ponerse en marcha.

587
00:41:25,652 --> 00:41:27,319
Y como dije, es
solamente una precaución

588
00:41:27,320 --> 00:41:29,655
- ¿Y tu hermana?
- Debe saberlo ya.

589
00:41:29,656 --> 00:41:32,824
Nos detendremos ahí luego
que hayamos salido de aquí.

590
00:41:32,825 --> 00:41:35,060
